yaml:
scenario: AKI_Staging_KDIGO
version: 1.0.0
description: Detect and stage acute kidney injury based on KDIGO criteria using serum
  creatinine
signals:
  Cr:
    ref: creatinine
    expected_unit: mg/dL
    description: Serum creatinine level
    concept_id: 19071968
    concept_code: '2913'
    vocabulary_id: RxNorm
trends:
  cr_delta_48h:
    expr: delta(Cr, 48h)
    description: Creatinine change over 48 hours
  cr_delta_24h:
    expr: delta(Cr, 24h)
    description: Creatinine change over 24 hours
  cr_current:
    expr: last(Cr)
    description: Current creatinine value
  cr_baseline:
    expr: first(Cr, 7d)
    description: Baseline creatinine value over the past 7 days
logic:
  aki_stage1_rise:
    when: cr_delta_48h >= 0.3
    severity: medium
    description: 'AKI Stage 1: Cr rise >= 0.3 mg/dL in 48h'
  aki_stage1_baseline:
    when: cr_current >= cr_baseline * 1.5 AND cr_current < cr_baseline * 2.0
    severity: medium
    description: 'AKI Stage 1: Cr 1.5 to 1.9 times baseline'
  aki_stage2:
    when: cr_current >= cr_baseline * 2.0 AND cr_current < cr_baseline * 3.0
    severity: high
    description: 'AKI Stage 2: Cr 2.0 to 2.9 times baseline'
  aki_stage3_absolute:
    when: cr_current >= 4.0
    severity: critical
    description: 'AKI Stage 3: Absolute Cr >= 4.0 mg/dL'
  aki_stage3_relative:
    when: cr_current >= cr_baseline * 3.0
    severity: critical
    description: 'AKI Stage 3: Cr >= 3.0 times baseline'
  aki_present:
    when: aki_stage1_rise OR aki_stage1_baseline OR aki_stage2 OR aki_stage3_absolute
      OR aki_stage3_relative
    severity: high
    description: AKI detected by any criterion
outputs:
  decision:
    has_aki:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.aki_present
      description: Patient has acute kidney injury
    stage1:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.aki_stage1_rise OR logic.aki_stage1_baseline
      description: Patient is in AKI Stage 1
    stage2:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.aki_stage2
      description: Patient is in AKI Stage 2
    stage3:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.aki_stage3_absolute OR logic.aki_stage3_relative
      description: Patient is in AKI Stage 3
  features:
    creatinine_change_48h:
      type: float
      from: trends.cr_delta_48h
      description: 48-hour creatinine change for risk modeling
    creatinine_change_24h:
      type: float
      from: trends.cr_delta_24h
      description: 24-hour creatinine change for risk modeling
    creatinine_current:
      type: float
      from: trends.cr_current
      description: Current creatinine level
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: When this evaluation was performed
warnings: Trend 'cr_delta_24h' is defined but not used in any logic rule
